about: Places in a saved franchise that hold wording as a finished sentence (it keeps the language it was written in). Recorded by tests/text-never-decides.test.js from one season. Award citations, free-agent clues, the Board goal, strategy notes, career events and the club log are saved lines (src/text/index.js) and follow the language; what is listed here is only the plain fragments left inside some club-log lines (parts of the staff's week summary, a Media Day headline). Do not add a place to make the test pass: save a line instead (line, lineParts, captured, lineField), or ask the owner.
